_comment: Hand reviewed. Calibrated on a 4 core host, 12 x paired min-of-5 runs on a 19602 triangle grid. Drift is reported, never auto refreshed. max_ratio sits above the observed max and is the blocking gate; ceiling_s is about 4x the observed worst candidate time and is reporting only (PerfCeilingWarning), because wall-clock seconds on a shared CI runner measure the runner (#1017).

verify_line_scan.calibration: #1153 item 7. 8-core desktop (Windows, Python 3.12), 12 x paired min-of-5 on the 1.3 MB plate in test_perf_gate_1153.py; one GcodeLines scan against the removed one-re-call-per-question path.

settings_read_cached.calibration: #1153 /config parse cache. Same host and method; a cached settings._read of the shipped home layer against _read_uncached (the parse every call used to pay).

loaded_spools_fuzzy.calibration: #1153 loaded_spools_dispatch near-miss scoring. 8-core desktop (Windows, Python 3.12), 6 x paired min-of-5 on the six plain messages in test_perf_gate_1153.py, fold memo cleared every run; the memoized fold and quick-ratio bounds against the frozen pre-change scorer.

baseline_config_scan.calibration: #1153 slice-path parsing. Same host and method; slice_guard._effective_config over the 1.3 MB plate in test_perf_gate_1153.py, skipping toolpath lines before the regex, against the removed per-line regex loop.
